description: Contract for the source interface: the report or dataset behind evidence records.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: DOI or accession — the immutable record ID of the source.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version or edition of the source report.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Stable URL of the source report.

fields.name: figure_table
fields.description: Figure, table or panel locator within the source.

fields.name: permission_status
fields.description: Whether permission exists to cite the source.
